e.title: OPIE (Open Policy Illustration Engine)
e.summary: 开源寿险保单演示引擎（确定性）：illustration 计算的开源实现
e.body:
OPIE（Open Policy Illustration Engine，PyPI）是确定性寿险保单演示引擎：按保单条款计算演示价值（现金价值、红利、退保价值等），用于销售演示与监管披露。对 RIAA：illustration（保单演示）是寿险实务核心流程——监管要求的标准化计算；与 [[lifelib]]（寿险现金流建模）、[[heavylight]]（建模范式）、[[ifrs17a]]（IFRS 17 计量）构成寿险「建模 → 演示 → 披露」链路；配合 [[rim539]]（寿险精算）理解演示价值的计算逻辑。

## 同类工具
[[pyscarcopula]]、[[qlifetable]]、[[qrmtools]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: Open-source deterministic life-insurance illustration engine: open implementation of illustration calculations
e.summary_hk: 開源壽險保單演示引擎（確定性）：illustration 計算的開源實現
e.body_en:
OPIE (Open Policy Illustration Engine, PyPI) is a deterministic life-insurance illustration engine: computing demonstration values per policy terms (cash value, dividends, surrender value) for sales illustrations and regulatory disclosure. For RIAA: illustration is a core life-insurance practice process with standardised regulatory calculations; with [[lifelib]] (life cashflow modelling), [[heavylight]] (modelling paradigms) and [[ifrs17a]] (IFRS 17 measurement) it completes the life modelling → illustration → disclosure chain; pair with [[rim539]] (life actuarial science) to understand how illustration values are computed.

## Similar tools
[[pyscarcopula]]、[[qlifetable]]、[[qrmtools]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
OPIE（Open Policy Illustration Engine，PyPI）是確定性壽險保單演示引擎：按保單條款計算演示價值（現金價值、紅利、退保價值等），用於銷售演示與監管披露。對 RIAA：illustration（保單演示）是壽險實務核心流程——監管要求的標準化計算；與 [[lifelib]]（壽險現金流建模）、[[heavylight]]（建模範式）、[[ifrs17a]]（IFRS 17 計量）構成壽險「建模 → 演示 → 披露」鏈路；配合 [[rim539]]（壽險精算）理解演示價值的計算邏輯。

## 同類工具
[[pyscarcopula]]、[[qlifetable]]、[[qrmtools]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
